w: Cape Town's celebrated unfinished highway: construction on this stub of a planned freeway began in the early 1970s and stopped in 1977 when the money ran out, leaving two concrete ramps pointing at empty air. Decades of film and fashion shoots later, the city announced in July 2026 it will finish the job.
s: Two concrete ramps to nowhere, unfinished since 1977
_facts: Incomplete section of the planned Eastern Boulevard Highway in Cape Town's CBD
Designed in the late 1960s; construction started early 1970s and ended, unfinished, in 1977 due to budget constraints
Became a popular tourist attraction and movie/fashion shoot location
In July 2026 the City of Cape Town announced it had formally decided to complete the bridge
